spatial_coverage.coverage: Global land-surface reanalysis coverage; the supplied study area is represented by one approximately 0.1° ERA5-Land grid cell containing both measurement sites.

data_description.temporal_coverage: 1950-01-01T01:00:00Z to 2026-07-01T23:00:00Z in the catalog; the paper uses daily values at 14:00 UTC across its 2019-2022 observation span.
analytical_capabilities: Extract hourly volumetric soil-water content for ERA5-Land soil layers
Select daily 14:00 UTC snapshots to match the paper's downloaded forcing data
Compare dynamic reanalysis soil moisture with in-situ measurements and terrain predictors
Construct temporal covariates for random-forest soil-moisture modeling
Analyze spatial and temporal soil-moisture variability at regional scale

unit_of_measurement.primary_measurement: Volumetric soil-water content in cubic metres per cubic metre (m³/m³) for the soil-layer bands; layer 1 represents 0-7 cm and layer 2 represents 7-28 cm in the supplied Methods.
unit_of_measurement.runtime_hint: Use `volumetric_soil_water_layer_1` and `volumetric_soil_water_layer_2` from the hourly collection. For paper-faithful inputs, select the 14:00 UTC image each day over the observation span, then sample the grid cell containing each field location. The authenticated catalog asset is an EPSG:4326, 0.1° grid with DOUBLE bands and MEAN pyramiding. Do not substitute `ECMWF/ERA5_LAND/MONTHLY_AGGR`: monthly aggregates do not preserve the daily 14:00 UTC temporal signal used here.

data_description.data_source: European Centre for Medium-Range Weather Forecasts (ECMWF), distributed through Google Earth Engine
